notes.title: Early Access Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]As we get closer to the release of V1.0 we would like to announce a few things that will change after the release of V1.0[/p][p][/p][h1]Pricing Update[/h1][p][/p][p]Before the release in Early Access, we announced the the pricing of the game would have increased after the release of V1.0[/p][p]Today we can confirm that the pricing [b]will remain the same as it was during Early Access [/b]and will not be subject to changes when V1.0 releases.[/p][p][/p][h1]Last Content Update[/h1][p][/p][p]V1.0 will be the last content update of the game. After that, only critical bug fixes updates will be released. This will allow us to fully focus on the development of our next game.[/p][p][/p][h1]V1.0 Release Date? [/h1][p][/p][p]We currently do not have a final release date for V1.0, but we can expect it to be released by late September 2025. But, we'll announce the date soon so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: The Hidden Room - Pyramid Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We know it has been a long time since the last major update, but we have been focusing on preparing The Hidden Room - Pyramid for the Early Access release, which is currently planned for...June 6th, 2024!

The game is currently in its final development stages, with all of the content already done for the Early Access release. During Early Access we will implement new features and improvements. The roadmap will be shared this week!
We can't wait to show you what we have been working on after the release of The Hidden Room! 👀


Thank you

notes.title: The Hidden Room - Pyramid Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We know it has been a long time since the last update, but we have been focusing on preparing the game for the Early Access release, which is currently planned for late May/early June 2024.
The game is currently in its final development stages, with basically all of the content already done for the Early Access release. During Early Access we will implement new features (we have a roadmap that we will share soon with everybody) and improvements.
We are planning on organizing one final playtest before the release, which is going to start next week if we don't encounter any major issues. 
The Playtest will be organized the same way as last time, but this time we will be focusing on bugs and not on performance (please note that we are still working on improving performance)
This time we have decided to keep the playtest once again as a Closed Beta, so only people that have also participated in the March Playtest can participate.
If you have been selected during the March Playtest, make sure to join the Closed Beta Discord Server; you can find the link in the Steam Discussions of the Closed Beta!
A new game description and new screenshots (more coming soon) are now available in the game's store page.
We will announce a final release date soon, so stay tuned!

Thank you
